api_feature_boundary.source_result: The selected API feature set does not itself enable optional risc0-zkvm, host, guest, CUDA, Arkworks, or proving backends. Permission/delegate generation and tree hashes are unconditional public exports.

raw_byte_bridge.numeric_opcode_result: All 40 declared OP_* constants in permission_script.rs match native numeric opcode IDs at both exact native revisions.
raw_byte_bridge.literal_push_scope: Emitter push_data supports raw lengths <=75. push_i64 emits 0x00,0x4f,0x51..0x60 or a length-prefixed signed-magnitude integer. Witness/redeem wrapping must use selected native ScriptBuilder and is not runtime-validated here.

native_opcode_body_differences.difference: 01b532e retains the 9fdb covenants_enabled=true boolean-pop branch; old pre-Toccata boolean branch is removed.
The 9fdb covenants_enabled guard is removed; the former enabled body remains, with formatting differences.
InvalidOutputIndex diagnostic length corrected from tx.inputs().len() to tx.outputs().len(). Valid access and out-of-range rejection remain unchanged.

raw_byte_bridge.comparison_condition: Compare 9fdb only with post-Toccata covenants_enabled=true. Its default/disabled mode is incompatible with these covenant scripts. 01b532e removes the activation switch and always uses post-Toccata behavior.
raw_byte_bridge.shared_engine_differences: 01b532e removes pre-Toccata minimal-push/numeric/boolean alternatives and split script limits, retaining post-Toccata operation and 1,000,000-byte script/element limits. Numeric IDs alone are not an engine equivalence proof.

spk_encoding.native_definition: crypto/txscript/src/lib.rs SpkEncoding::to_bytes: u16 version.to_be_bytes() followed by raw script bytes; function identical in both pins.
spk_encoding.native_p2sh_definition: crypto/txscript/src/standard.rs:51-54; unkeyed Blake2b-256(redeem), native P2SH script. standard.rs and script_class.rs are byte-identical across pins.
spk_encoding.vprogs_source: permission_script.rs:638-645 emits literal 00 00 aa 20 before redeem hash, then 87.
spk_encoding.documentation_discrepancy: Emitter comment says TX_VERSION (0) as 2B LE. Native SPK encoding actually uses SPK version as u16 BE. Version zero has identical BE/LE bytes, so selected version-zero bytes agree. Freeze version 0; do not generalize that comment to a nonzero version.

covenants_context.input_membership: Only supplied UTXO entries with Some(covenant_id) populate shared input indices.
covenants_context.output_membership: CovenantBinding outputs with the authorizing input UTXO covenant ID are continuation outputs and populate per-input/shared contexts. Genesis groups validate reconstructed ID but do not populate continuation contexts.
covenants_context.terminal_implication: Selected count1->0 branch requires num_covenant_outputs(current input covenant ID)==0. No successor/continuation is allowed.
covenants_context.validator_difference: 9fdb gates covenant-context construction and EngineFlags by Toccata activation. 01b532e removes the activation split and always calls CovenantsContext::from_tx; exact validator hashes recorded above.
covenants_context.boundary: This compares supplied-UTXO interpretation, not global spent-set or private note ancestry evidence.

semantics: Current delegate input index must be >0.
Input0 supplied UTXO covenant_id, or zero hash if absent, must equal embedded covenant ID.
Input0 signature-script slice [len-2,len) must equal 51 75 (OpTrue OpDrop). Undersized scripts or invalid slices error.
Return true. No permission-holder signature is required by this public trigger branch. Authorization comes from input0 permission payout-to-committed-recipient checks; input0 must itself pass Full.
delegate_entry.substring_native_contract: OpTxInputScriptSigSubstr pops [input_index,start,end] with end exclusive. Same contract in both pins; 9fdb requires covenants_enabled=true.
delegate_entry.permission_trailer: Official permission emitter ends OpTrue OpTrue OpDrop. Pushed redeem must remain last in input0 signature script, preserving raw final bytes 51 75.
delegate_entry.not_sufficient_alone: Covenant ID and trailer alone do not prove input0 is the intended permission program. Probe must supply official permission P2SH and validate every input under Full, including external fee signature.

permission_sources: permission_script.rs:408-450 terminal payout and no continuation
terminal_and_fee_findings.terminal_root_limit: Normal one-leaf accumulator uses depth 1. Both Merkle walks execute, but final branch discards computed new root. Missing old/new path-witness binding remains a continuing-root safety blocker, explicitly excluded.
terminal_and_fee_findings.self_funded_positive_fee_result: Final payout >= deduct + permission rent, and delegate change equals recognized delegate inputs minus deduct. All protocol input value remains required in protocol outputs. Positive miner fee needs nondelegate external capital; no-external claim-funded-fee attempt must retain rejection.
terminal_and_fee_findings.external_fee_positive_is_not_project_tar: An external-fee case cannot establish 60M principal paying its own positive miner fee while preserving target payout.
